content: {"episode_id":"ep-05002","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"I appeal the CO-197 denial for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229), acknowledging that authorization is missing. The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of underlying rhythm disturbances, with a history of atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptoms with arrhythmic events and assess the efficacy of current rate control management."}
